banking-economy.title: RBI issues final leverage ratio rules for banks, effective April 2027
banking-economy.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has announced final leverage ratio requirements for commercial banks, to be implemented starting April 1, 2027. Domestic systemically important banks must maintain a minimum leverage ratio of 4%, while other commercial banks need a ratio of 3.5%.
